items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED LESSONS (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse, ~2-tile radius); bomb count decrements on placement. Q and Space do nothing. Diagonal/single-axis moves stall against rocks whose hitboxes exceed their sprites; reposition lanes instead of pushing.

TECH X (confirmed in run, respawnable): pill pedestal in the two-poop room re-grants Tech X on entry. Firing produces a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15–0.2 room-units) in the firing direction on the player's row/column; rocks block it; vertical/horizontal alignment matters. The RED SQUIGGLY RING seen after firing is just my own laser effect — NOT a lock icon, breakable marker, or enemy telegraph (this corrects an earlier belief; the 'red padlock' reading is doubtful/uncertain).

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: Gray chests open by contact in TNT room lore but the left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are INERT decorations, not chests (confirmed no reaction). Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact and yields a coin (coins 00→01) — do not waste lasers on it (many hits did nothing). Red-lidded brown barrels/containers strongly suspected KEY-LOCKED (keys counter has never risen above 00 anywhere; a key-shaped pickup earlier did not raise it). Torch-room center gray chest is fully sealed by indestructible rocks — tested left, top, and right approaches, all blocked; ABANDON it.

BOMBS — FAILED STRATEGY: bombs damage self. Bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing; warping away does NOT outrun the fuse. Never bomb at low hearts or adjacent to self; retreat to a far corner if ever bombing. Rocks are not destructible (judged).

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOB in the rock field damages on contact (cost a heart, second confirmed occurrence) — treat as trap, keep away. Rock field is a heart-drainer; don't camp doorways; white-faced chasers can be killed safely at range with Tech X. Blobs transform (winged/spread/large fast green forms). Spike-enclosed chest in the dark chest room is untouchable. Corner torches damage on touch.

PICKUPS: hearts need overlap (+1). Coin pot yielded a coin on break; coin tolerance otherwise unresolved (some gold specks never register). Bomb-fuse sprite in TNT room is a BOMB PICKUP (auto-collects, harmless). Bomb pickups auto-collect on overlap.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (refined): requires near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1–0.2 units from the frame; standing on the frame blocks the warp — step back ~0.2, re-center, then hold the direction. Sometimes multiple attempts; if it fails, back off and re-center rather than pressing harder.

MAP / ROUTES:
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 ↔ rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room; right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch ↔ tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 ↔ TNT room; keyhole door left wall ~x0.19–0.20, y~0.44–0.48 (no key yet).
- Torch room: top hatch x~0.50 ↔ tutorial; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76–0.79 ↔ two-poop room (approach ~0.1 above, centered); safe left lane x~0.31–0.42 full height; right lane x~0.63 traversable down.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1 below); poop piles regenerate on re-entry and drop nothing; center rock indestructible.
- TNT room (rock-field top exit): TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot at close range); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 ↔ pink-enemy room; bottom hatch ↔ rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies, rock wall right with a poop pile containing gold/blue flies, three dark teardrop pickups, gray chest with spiky black edges at left. Pink enemy behavior UNTESTED.
- Dark chest room (right of tutorial): chaser den; two red-lidded brown containers; central red-lidded chest in white spikes; black blob/pit shapes; gold/olive specks.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource; keys never obtained (counter stays 00). Open red-lidded/ringed containers, presumed key-locked. Test the rock-field keyhole door only with a confirmed key.

UNRESOLVED: where/whether keys exist; what opens the keyhole door; contents of the torch-room enclosed chest; nature of the dark teardrop pickups in the pink room; green gem/blob effect beyond heart loss; exact coin pickup tolerance; whether lasers can open any chest through a rock ring (evidence: no)."}</｜｜DSML｜｜>
